name: dashboard
title: Dashboard
description: A full dashboard made only with mangacn: a collapsible Sidebar (a sheet on phones), four Stat key figures, a bar chart and a line chart in screentone patterns (Chart), a Data Table of chapters with Badge statuses, a period switch (Button Group of pressed buttons) and a Command palette opened with Ctrl/⌘ K. Works in light, dark, any accent and at phone width.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/dashboard". The root fills its container: pass className="h-svh" for a whole screen.

meta.tagline: Sidebar, key figures, toned charts, a data table and a command palette.
